watch.text: Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (ankle) and Cason Wallace are out long term; Mara, Topic and Jaylin Williams are also out vs MIN tonight, NBA 11:30 AM ET report.
SGA returned 11/24 at Indiana (125-120 loss) after missing 11/22 at Miami; he and Alex Caruso are not on tonight's 11:30 AM ET report.
Giannis Antetokounmpo (right groin tendinitis) missed Sunday vs OKC and is upgraded to probable at PHI tonight on the NBA's 3:30 PM ET report.
Stephen Curry (oblique tear, hurt 11/11 at Houston) has missed 5 straight (Warriors 1-4) and is out vs SAC tonight; Lendeborg is questionable, Butler and Moody out, NBA 11:30 AM ET report.
Tatum and White sat the 97-96 loss at SAC on 11/21 but are off the 11/22 report vs GS; that loss understates the Boston that plays tonight.
Mitchell Robinson (illness) is still listed out for 11/24 at WSH (ESPN return estimate 11/27); Paul George, rested 11/22 at GS, is expected back.
Norman Powell (hamstring) and Caleb Wilson (hand fracture), the Bulls' two leading scorers, are out at CHA tonight; Jalen Smith is questionable (illness), NBA 11:30 AM ET report.
Jalen Brunson (illness) is questionable vs CLE tonight; OG Anunoby, Miles McBride and Jordan Clarkson are out; Towns and Hart upgraded to probable (NBA 1:30 PM ET report).
Siakam (hip) is questionable vs OKC on 11/23; Nesmith and McConnell are out and Haliburton remains out.
P.J. Washington (illness) is questionable at DEN on 11/24 after missing two games (took part in shootaround); Dereck Lively II (foot surgery) is out.
CJ McCollum (calf) is out at least four weeks from 11/17 and Landale is out; Flemings (lumbar) is questionable vs DET.
Jalen Duren (hamstring) and Duncan Robinson (quad) are out at ORL on the NBA's 5:30 PM ET report on 11/24; Cade Cunningham (knee soreness) is probable.
Lauri Markkanen (hand fracture, 11/11, at least a month) has missed 9 straight games and Jaren Jackson Jr. (MCL) 14 straight; ratings still carry early games with them.
Centers Jusuf Nurkic (foot, out since 11/20) and Jaxson Hayes (knee, ruled out 11/23) are both out vs the Lakers, thinning Utah's frontcourt further.
Paolo Banchero (right high-ankle sprain) is still out vs DET on the 5:30 PM ET report on 11/24; Jonathan Isaac is out too.
Joel Embiid (illness) missed Monday vs POR and is ruled out vs MIA tonight on the NBA's 3:30 PM ET report.
Wembanyama (low back) and Fox (shin) sat 11/23 at Sacramento and are questionable at POR tonight; Dylan Harper (hip) and Tobias Harris (calf) are out, NBA 11:30 AM ET report.
Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (meniscus) are out vs SA tonight on the NBA's 11:30 AM ET report; Krejci and Youngblood are out too.
Cameron Boozer (ankle) and Jerami Grant (calf) are out vs LAC tonight; GG Jackson, Pippen Jr. and Saunders are out too, NBA 11:30 AM ET report.
Kon Knueppel and Dennis Schroder (hamstrings) are out vs CHI and Ryan Kalkbrenner is doubtful (hip); Grayson Allen is questionable (concussion), NBA 11:30 AM ET report.
Austin Reaves (35.2 mpg, left heel bruise) is out vs Utah on 11/23, his 4th straight missed game; ESPN's injury report lists Friday 11/27 as his target.
Walker Kessler returns from injury for Monday's game vs Utah.
Nolan Traore (22.3 mpg) has a right hamstring strain, re-evaluated in about 8-10 weeks; he is out at MIL tonight on the NBA's 11:30 AM ET report.
Evan Mobley (left great toe sprain) and Nae'Qwan Tomlin (back) are out at NY tonight on the NBA's 1:30 PM ET report.
Anthony Edwards (right knee arthroscopy) has been out since late October; DiVincenzo (Achilles) and Jaylen Clark are out at OKC tonight, NBA 11:30 AM ET report.
Maxime Raynaud (right patella subluxation) and Ben Simmons are out at GS tonight on the NBA's 11:30 AM ET report.

401910035.summary: Curry's absence and Tatum/White returning explain most of the gap, but Boston ruling out Paul George and Mitchell Robinson on 11/22 pushes back toward GS; the line moved from Celtics -8.5 to -7.5.

reasons.text: Stephen Curry (oblique tear) is out vs BOS, ESPN estimates Dec 12; our ratings still carry his 13 games.
Tatum (rest) and White (AC joint) sat at SAC on 11/21 but are off the injury report for the GS game on 11/22.
Paul George (rest) and Mitchell Robinson (illness) were ruled out for Boston at GS on 11/22.

returning.text: Rested 11/21 at SAC; off the 11/22 injury report and expected to play at GS.
Missed 11/21 at SAC (AC joint contusion); off the 11/22 injury report vs GS.

swings.BOS: Tatum and White sat at SAC on 11/21, so the market was low on Boston there; both are off the 11/22 report, so the market prices them back at GS (RotoWire, 11/22).

swings.PHI: Jaylen Brown and Dean Wade (hamstrings) missed two games and are probable vs POR on 11/23; the market prices them back, our ratings don't (ESPN, 11/22).
swings.POR: Nothing found on Portland itself; the move most likely reflects Philadelphia's Brown and Wade being listed probable after missing two games (ESPN, 11/22).

returning.text: Probable vs POR after missing two games (hamstring).
Probable vs POR after missing two games (hamstring).

401910037.summary: Philadelphia gets Jaylen Brown and Dean Wade (hamstrings) back as probable and is on a five-game win streak, while Portland is without Ja Morant and Shaedon Sharpe; that covers part of the gap.

reasons.text: Joel Embiid is still questionable (illness) on the 5:30 PM ET official report for 11/23, which may weigh on the 76ers' price.
Brown and Wade (hamstrings) are probable vs POR after missing two games; Adem Bona is also listed.
Portland is out Ja Morant (hamstring, est. Dec 1), Shaedon Sharpe (meniscus, est. March), Vit Krejci and Chris Youngblood.

401910045.summary: The Spurs ruled out Victor Wembanyama (low back tightness, his first missed game of the season) and De'Aaron Fox (shin) at Sacramento, so the market's discount on San Antonio is explained.

reasons.text: Wembanyama (low back tightness) and Fox (right shin contusion) are OUT tonight at SAC after both took part in shootaround; Jordan McLaughlin (shoulder) was cleared.
Wembanyama (back) is questionable for Monday at SAC; Fox (right shin contusion) and Jordan McLaughlin (shoulder) are also questionable.

swings.SA: Wembanyama (back) and Fox (shin) were ruled out for 11/23 at Sacramento; the market discounts the Spurs, our ratings don't (KSAT, 11/23).

401910040.summary: Anthony Edwards has been out since Oct. 29 knee surgery, so our ratings already carry most of it; Brooklyn now loses Nolan Traore for 8-10 weeks, which pushes the other way, so the gap stays unexplained.

reasons.text: Edwards had right knee arthroscopic surgery on Oct. 29 and is expected to miss at least eight weeks (late December).
Nets: Nolan Traore (hamstring strain) will be re-evaluated in about 8-10 weeks (HoopsHype via ESPN, 11/23), which favors Minnesota, not the market's number.
5:30 PM ET report: Edwards (knee), DiVincenzo and Jaylen Clark out for Minnesota; Traore out for Brooklyn, Grant Nelson (ankle) available.

swings.BKN: Nolan Traore (hamstring strain) went from game-time decision to an 8-10 week re-evaluation on 11/23 (HoopsHype via ESPN); the market has moved on Brooklyn with it.
swings.MIN: Nothing found: the market moved on Minnesota without a clear reason; Edwards (out since Oct. 29 knee surgery), Clark and DiVincenzo were already out last game, and only Brooklyn's Traore and Nelson are game-time calls (ESPN, 11/23).

swings.PHX: Trey Murphy III (knees) is probable for New Orleans vs PHX after missing 7 of 8 games (29 min in his 11/20 return); the market prices him back, our ratings don't (Rotowire, 11/22).

swings.OKC: SGA (neck/back) missed Sunday at Miami but is off Monday's injury report (CBS, 11/23 1:42 PM); with Holmgren, Jalen Williams and Caruso still out, the gap on OKC fell from 9.7 to 1.7.

401910036.summary: Memphis is without Cameron Boozer (2nd straight game) and Jerami Grant, which pulled the line from 3.5 to 2.5, but Charlotte is missing four rotation players too, so it covers only part of our 3.5-pt gap.

reasons.text: Grizzlies: Cameron Boozer (ankle sprain, 2nd straight missed game) and Jerami Grant (calf strain, re-evaluated in two weeks) are out at Charlotte.
Hornets: Grayson Allen (concussion protocol), Kon Knueppel and Dennis Schroder (hamstrings) and Grant Williams are out; Brandon Miller is available (5:30 PM ET official report).
Line: Memphis opened -3.5 and most books still show -3.5; DraftKings is at -2.5.

swings.LAL: Market is higher on the Lakers than at their last game even with Austin Reaves ruled out a 4th straight game: Walker Kessler returns from injury and Utah is still without Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr. (Yahoo, 11/23).

swings.BOS: At GS on 11/22 the market priced Stephen Curry's absence (our ratings don't see it) and we sat 7.2 lower on Boston; at WSH the Wizards have no new absence and Paul George (rested 11/22) is expected back, so the gap closed to 2.2 (CelticsBlog, 11/23).

401909315.summary: Boston's three straight one-possession losses (two with Tatum or White out) drag our rating; with Tatum, White and Paul George expected back the market has moved from Celtics -10.5 to -11.5.

reasons.text: Boston lost 105-101 at DEN, 97-96 at SAC (Tatum and White sat) and 88-87 at GS (George rested); our ratings carry those games at full weight.
The 6:30 PM ET official report lists only Mitchell Robinson (illness) out for Boston; Washington has Beekman, Champagnie, Vukcevic and Watkins out and Tre Mann (illness) questionable.

401909316.summary: Dallas is without Dereck Lively II at altitude and P.J. Washington (illness) is a game-time call after joining shootaround, which covers part of the gap between our Nuggets -5 and the market's -8.5; Denver lists no injuries.

reasons.text: P.J. Washington (illness) is still questionable after missing the last two games, but he took part in Tuesday's shootaround in Denver; Caleb Martin is available in a thumb splint.
Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Tobi Lawal (groin), Tarik Biberovic and Sergio de Larrea are out for Dallas; Denver has no players on the 4:30 PM report.
Denver has no players on ESPN's injury report and has won three straight, including 151-145 vs Chicago on 11/22.

swings.DAL: At Utah on 11/22 the market was higher on Dallas than we were against a Jazz team missing Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr.; now it is lower on Dallas at Denver with Washington iffy and Lively out (Rotowire, ESPN, 11/23).

401909320.summary: Market has OKC -3.5 at home; Minnesota is also short-handed (Edwards out), and OKC's own absences are already in our number, so nothing clearly justifies the extra 3.4 pts.

reasons.text: OKC is without Jalen Williams (leg, out until March), Holmgren (knee) and Caruso and Topic (hips); SGA played 38 min in Monday's 125-120 loss at Indiana.
Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, ESPN return estimate Dec 21) and DiVincenzo (Achilles), yet won Monday 142-116 vs Brooklyn.

swings.OKC: Last game (Sunday at Miami) OKC played without SGA, Holmgren and Jalen Williams, so the market faded it far more than our ratings did; with SGA back (38 min Monday at IND) the gap narrowed.

swings.MIA: Sunday's game vs OKC came with SGA, Holmgren and J. Williams out (market had MIA -4.5, we were far lower on Miami); vs PHI that is gone, Giannis is probable and Embiid out (3:30 PM ET report).

401909324.summary: Golden State is without Curry, Butler, Porzingis and Moody; our rating still carries Curry's early games, which explains part of why we're higher on the Warriors (6 of the last 6).

reasons.text: Stephen Curry (oblique tear) is out vs SAC and has missed 5 straight; Butler (ACL), Moody (patellar tendon) are out, Porzingis is not with the team, Lendeborg questionable.
Sacramento (2-15) is without Maxime Raynaud and Ben Simmons, which pushes the other way, so the Warriors' absences don't cover the whole gap.

401909318.summary: Both teams are short-handed (Chicago without Powell and Wilson, Charlotte without Knueppel and Schroder); the market leans on the Bulls' missing scorers more than our ratings do.

reasons.text: Chicago's two leading scorers, Norman Powell (hamstring) and Caleb Wilson (hand fracture), are out; Jalen Smith is questionable (illness), NBA 11:30 AM ET report.
Charlotte has Kon Knueppel and Dennis Schroder out and Ryan Kalkbrenner doubtful; Grayson Allen is questionable (concussion protocol).

returning.text: Questionable (concussion protocol) on the 11:30 AM ET report after missing two games.

swings.BKN: Nolan Traore (22.3 mpg) went out on 11/23 with a hamstring strain (8-10 weeks; out at MIL on the 11/25 11:30 AM ET report), so the market came down on Brooklyn toward our lower number.

swings.SA: Wembanyama (back) and Fox (shin) sat 11/23 at Sacramento, which made the market lower on San Antonio last game; both are questionable at POR tonight on the 11:30 AM ET report; Harper and Harris remain out.

401909319.summary: The market has cut the Knicks from -5.5 to -1.5 because Jalen Brunson is now questionable (illness) on top of Anunoby, McBride and Clarkson being out; Cleveland is without Evan Mobley.

reasons.text: Jalen Brunson (illness) was added as questionable on the NBA's 1:30 PM ET report; the line fell from Knicks -5.5 at the open to -1.5.
New York is also without OG Anunoby (calf), Miles McBride (adductor) and Jordan Clarkson (plantar fasciitis); Towns and Hart are probable.
Cleveland's Evan Mobley (toe) and Nae'Qwan Tomlin (back) are out, which offsets part of the Knicks' absences.
